title: Saul Anointed King

questions.question: What did Samuel anoint Saul with?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:1 (ESV): “Then Samuel took a flask of oil and poured it on his head...”

questions.question: What did Samuel say would happen to Saul among the prophets?
options: He would prophesy and be turned into another man
questions.correctAnswer: He would prophesy and be turned into another man
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:6 (ESV): “...you will prophesy with them and be turned into another man.”

questions.question: Where was Saul publicly chosen as king?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:17 (ESV): “Now Samuel called the people together to the Lord at Mizpah.”

questions.question: Where was Saul hiding when chosen?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:22 (ESV): “...‘Behold, he has hidden himself among the baggage.’”

questions.question: Who despised Saul?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:27 (ESV): “But some worthless fellows said, ‘How can this man save us?’...”

questions.question: What was the first sign Samuel gave Saul (concerning Rachel's tomb)?
options: Two men would tell him the donkeys were found
questions.correctAnswer: Two men would tell him the donkeys were found
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:2 (ESV): "...you will meet two men by Rachel's tomb... and they will say to you, 'The donkeys... have been found...'"

questions.question: What was the second sign concerning the oak of Tabor?
options: Three men going up to God at Bethel will meet you
questions.correctAnswer: Three men going up to God at Bethel will meet you
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:3 (ESV): "Then you shall go on... to the oak of Tabor. Three men going up to God at Bethel will meet you there..."

questions.question: What proverb became popular regarding Saul?
options: Is Saul also among the prophets?
questions.correctAnswer: Is Saul also among the prophets?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:11 (ESV): "...the people said to one another... 'Is Saul also among the prophets?'"

questions.question: Did Saul tell his uncle about the kingship?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:16 (ESV): "...But about the matter of the kingdom, of which Samuel had spoken, he told him nothing."

questions.question: How was the king chosen at Mizpah?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:20-21 (ESV): Describes the process of taking tribes and families by lot until Saul was taken.

questions.question: Where is Rachel's tomb located according to Samuel?
options: In the territory of Benjamin at Zelzah
questions.correctAnswer: In the territory of Benjamin at Zelzah
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:2 (ESV): "...by Rachel's tomb in the territory of Benjamin at Zelzah..."

questions.question: What were the three men carrying in the second sign?
options: Three kids (goats), three loaves of bread, and a skin of wine
questions.correctAnswer: Three kids (goats), three loaves of bread, and a skin of wine
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:3 (ESV): "...one carrying three young goats, another carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a skin of wine."

questions.question: What musical instruments were the prophets playing?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:5 (ESV): "...with harp, tambourine, flute, and lyre before them..."

questions.question: What book did Samuel write and lay up before the Lord?
options: The rights and duties of the kingship
questions.correctAnswer: The rights and duties of the kingship
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:25 (ESV): "Then Samuel told the people the rights and duties of the kingship, and he wrote them in a book and laid it up before the LORD."

questions.question: Who went home with Saul to Gibeah?
options: Men of valor whose hearts God had touched
questions.correctAnswer: Men of valor whose hearts God had touched
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:26 (ESV): "Saul also went to his home at Gibeah, and with him went men of valor whose hearts God had touched."

key_verse_text: And Samuel said to all the people, “Do you see him whom the LORD has chosen? There is none like him among all the people.” And all the people shouted, “Long live the king!” (ESV)
